proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing charge-cast magic-item pattern can grant access to a spell, but it cannot override the spell's normal DC source with an item-defined fixed DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) from it

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.target_predicate.has_speed
proposed_widenings.justification: The item narrows the granted spell to a subset of the spell's normal legal targets: only Beasts that have a Swim Speed. The current spell-access surface has no way to add that extra eligibility predicate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: on a Beast that has a Swim Speed

notes: Magic-item activation with a charge pool and dawn recharge fits. I did not author content because encoding it as plain charge-cast Dominate Beast would silently use the spell's normal DC source and drop the swim-speed target restriction.
